title: A Volunteer Shift at the Community Library · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about your weekly routine. Use I, we, or they and the simple present. Include one time expression (for example, at nine o'clock) and one frequency word (for example, always or sometimes).
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
